sources: https://frenchcreekfarms.com/wp-json/wp/v2/mphb_room_type (the site's own MotoPress booking listings, one per campsite)

values.note: Field sites from $30, waterfront sites from $35, large sites from $45 a night; $5 per person over the site's standard 8. 5% off per night for 7-13 nights, 10% for 14-15. Cabin from $65, cottage from $150.

fees.source: https://frenchcreekfarms.com/camping/ (Camping Rates page, updated 2025-07-14: 'Field sites start at $30', 'Waterfront sites start at $35', 'Large sites start at $45'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 19 numbered campsites, each listed with a camper size: #1 and #16-19 (field/woodland) 30 ft, #3-5 25 ft, #9 20 ft, #6, #10, #11 40 ft, #2, #7, #8, #12-15 50 ft (waterfront view). Mary's Meadow is a separate tent/walk-in group site.

sites.source: https://frenchcreekfarms.com/camp-map-area-attractions/ ('Campsite #1' to 'Campsite #19') + the operator's booking listings (e.g. 'Campsite #14 Camper Size 50ft, Waterfront View', 'Campsite #19 Camper Size 30ft, Field/Woodland View'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: All bookings through the campground's own website; no cash walk-ins or drive-ins. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am; refund (less a 3.3% card fee) for cancellations 6 or more days ahead.

booking.source: https://frenchcreekfarms.com/camping/ ('All bookings are handled through the website to avoid double bookings. No cash walk-ins/drive-ins'; check-in/out; cancellation policy), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed 19 sites, $30-45 (rates page updated July 2025), online booking with no walk-ins. Added max rig 50 ft (several waterfront sites list 50-ft campers; field sites 30 ft), fcfs never. The operator's pages I read say nothing about hookups (the stored no-hookups and drinking water are from the note) or season, so those were left alone.
